amendments.reason: Explicit legacy PCSR response framing and request identity; register reads unchanged. Regression tests: test_v10_2_pcsr_response.py.
Four optional best-effort progress events only; no change to command construction, submission, waiting, or timeout handling. Verified by AST comparison removing _freeze_emit calls.
Normalize only line-boundary NUL in raw Telnet PCSR replies. Reproduced exact user response and fragmented CR/NUL input; internal corruption remains rejected.

Last-resort probe USB recovery appended to the restart ladder (_probe_usb_devices/_probe_usb_recover + tail of _reconnect). Purely additive: PC read path (_read_all_pcs, _telnet_cmd, PCSR framing) is byte-identical; the only deletion is one log string. Scope is limited to USB devices matching configured vendor ids; the DUT is NVMe/PCIe and is not touched. v10.2 stays on the frozen baseline. Regression tests: test_v10_3_probe_recovery.py.

Sampler failure diagnostics. (a) OpenOCD stdout/stderr go to a file instead of unread PIPEs — an undrained pipe blocks OpenOCD on write once the 64 KiB buffer fills, which silently kills the telnet path after days of error lines. (b) On read failure, DP DPIDR/CTRL-STAT are logged BEFORE the sticky clear that used to erase them (read-only, throttled, exception-proof). (c) Cumulative counters (uptime/reads/reinit/reconnect). (d) Restart ladder varies adapter speed instead of repeating one setting. (e) Optional RSS/fd trend thread. PC read path (framing, parsing, success path) is unchanged — additions only; deletions are confined to _launch_openocd/_reconnect and docstrings. Diagnostics never raise into the read path. Tests: test_v10_3_sampler_diag.py.

Send-time block for (opcode, CDW value) pairs — strategy.blocked_cdw_rules. The rules are product-agnostic and live under strategy, not a product profile. Vendor 0xC0 with CDW12=0x2 permanently closes the debug port; a power cycle does not restore it (factory reset required), so the sample can no longer be sampled — the root cause behind the OpenOCD port 4444 wait timeout. 0xC0 is not a named command and only appears through opcode mutation (randint(0xC0,0xFF)), so neither CMD_SCHEMAS nor excluded_opcodes can reach it; the transport chokepoint is the only place that sees the value. The change is purely additive (81 insertions, 0 deletions): one early-return guard placed directly after the excluded_opcodes guard, before any command construction. Blocked commands return RC_SKIP, which the accounting path already treats as 'never sent' (no executions, coverage, or crash attribution). Every other transport guard, argument assembly, and rc handling is byte-identical. Frozen v10.2 hash unchanged. Tests: test_v10_3_cmd_block.py (15, real _send_nvme_command; injection-verified by removing the value comparison and the scope check).

Reviewed v11 opt-in post-Popen hook. Command construction and transport guards unchanged. Hook exists only in v11 mixin; consumed reservation time is subtracted from ordinary wait on missed injection. An explicitly preserved v11 failure does not kill the pending ioctl. Frozen v10.2 hash is unchanged. RealTransportIntegration tests exercise disabled transport, injection, PM exclusion, next-command watchdog restoration and sequence continuation using actual method with mocked Popen.

Activate v11 device-path freeze using the already reviewed v10.3 overrides. All five guarded AST paths are identical to their reviewed baselines; no hashes regenerated. v10.2/v10.3 remain frozen legacy checks. Future engine changes target v11 only.

v11.1 is a new file copied from v11 (run record, LLM share chart, CSFuzz p fix, compare tool). All five guarded AST paths are identical to the reviewed v11 baselines; no hashes regenerated. v11 stays frozen as a legacy check. Future engine changes target v11.1.

RiscvPcsrSampler: overlay bank probe failures (read fail / unresolvable word, not swaps) are counted per core; after _OVL_FAIL_LIMIT consecutive failed bursts the core's bank resolution is turned off and samples are kept as bank 0 instead of being silently dropped (field: ovl-drop 100% after recovery = zero PC collection). Streak resets on success and on re-probe at connect. Reviewed; only this class hash changes for v11.1.

overrides_note: hashes 는 모든 DEVICE_AST_FILES 에 적용되는 기준선이다. overrides 는 검토를 거쳐 **특정 파일에서만** 의도적으로 달라진 경로를 기록한다. v10.2 는 검증된 fallback 이라 계속 기준선 그대로여야 하고, 여기 올라오지 않은 파일·경로는 전부 기준선에 묶인다.
